name: 01752 · Marlborough, MA
findings: ZIP 01752 (Marlborough) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01752 (Marlborough) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01752 (Marlborough) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
